name: proven
description: Proven: a shared evidence and growth platform for small businesses and the organisations that fund them.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @proven/engine && npm run typecheck --workspace @proven/app
scripts.dev: npm run build:engine && npm run dev --workspace @proven/app
scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build --workspace @proven/app
scripts.verify: npm run build:engine && npm test && npm run typecheck
